title: Open Mic Night @ Lovin' Cup
event_description: A long-running, low-tech weekly open mic on a professional stage near RIT, welcoming singers, songwriters, comedians, poets and storytellers. Sign up early, since slots fill fast.
backline: Professional stage, house PA and lighting; house piano available
event_venue_information:
Lovin' Cup

Lovin' Cup is a bistro and brewery at Park Point near RIT, combining a full kitchen and house-brewed beer with a professional-grade stage, sound system and lighting rig that make it one of Rochester's most performer-friendly rooms.

Open Mic Night

Every Tuesday night, Lovin' Cup has hosted a free, low-tech open mic since 2009, welcoming singers, songwriters, instrumentalists, comedians, poets, storytellers and dancers. A house piano is available, and microphones are sanitized between each performer. Sign-up begins at 6:30 PM, with organizers encouraging performers to arrive early to guarantee a slot.

Other Events

Beyond the weekly open mic, Lovin' Cup regularly books touring and local bands, benefiting from its proper concert-grade sound and lighting setup.

Good to Know

Lovin' Cup is located at 300 Park Point Drive, Rochester, NY 14623. Because the format is low-tech, full bands, drum kits and large amplifiers aren't accommodated at the open mic.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Bernunzio Uptown Music
event_description: A second-Saturday bluegrass jam inside a vintage instrument shop, split into a slower guided hour followed by faster-tempo picking focused on soloing and ear training.
backline: Acoustic jam in the store's back room; bring your own instrument
event_venue_information:
Bernunzio Uptown Music

Bernunzio Uptown Music is a vintage and used instrument specialist on East Avenue with 50 years of history buying and selling guitars, banjos, mandolins and ukuleles from top American makers. Beyond retail, the shop's back room doubles as a genuine community jam space.

Bluegrass Jam

On second Saturdays from noon to 3:00 PM, Bernunzio hosts an Intermediate+ Bluegrass Jam split into two parts: a slower first hour focused on guided repertoire, followed by two hours at faster tempos emphasizing soloing, breaks and ear training around traditional bluegrass standards. All instruments are welcome and it's a drop-in format.

Other Events

The shop regularly hosts additional acoustic jam sessions and clinics tied to its vintage-instrument inventory, drawing pickers from across the Rochester area.

Good to Know

Bernunzio Uptown Music is located at 122 East Ave, Rochester, NY 14604. Street parking is free, with additional parking in the East End Garage behind the store.

title: Jazz On Tap @ Vine & Tap Wine Bar
event_description: A weekly Friday jazz session in a Charlotte neighborhood wine bar, featuring a rotating lineup of local musicians in a relaxed setting over wine and charcuterie.
event_venue_information:
Vine & Tap Wine Bar

Vine & Tap is a wine bar in Rochester's Charlotte neighborhood along Lake Ave, offering a rotating menu of wine, beer and charcuterie sourced from across the Finger Lakes, alongside guided tastings and weekly food pairings.

Jazz On Tap

Every Friday evening from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM, Vine & Tap hosts Jazz On Tap, a live jazz session with a rotating lineup of local musicians. The relaxed, wine-bar setting makes it a comfortable spot for both listening and sitting in.

Other Events

Vine & Tap also books local bands on Saturday nights, rounding out a weekend built around live music and wine.

Good to Know

Vine & Tap Wine Bar is located at 4768 Lake Ave, Rochester, NY 14612, in the Charlotte neighborhood near the Lake Ontario waterfront. Check the venue's website for the week's featured lineup.

title: Open Blues Jam @ Main Place Tavern
event_description: A weekly Sunday blues jam organized by the Blues Society of Western New York, welcoming musicians of all levels to sit in with a house band on the city's east side.
hosts: Blues Society of Western New York
event_venue_information:
Main Place Tavern

Main Place Tavern is a neighborhood bar on East Main Street on Rochester's east side, known for a casual, unpretentious atmosphere and a full bar menu.

Open Blues Jam

Every Sunday evening from 6:30 PM to 9:30 PM, the Blues Society of Western New York hosts an Open Blues Jam at Main Place Tavern, welcoming musicians of all levels to sit in with a house band and play blues standards in front of a supportive crowd.

Other Events

Main Place Tavern also hosts occasional live band nights and community gatherings tied to the local blues and bar scene.

Good to Know

Main Place Tavern is located at 1899 E Main St, Rochester, NY 14609. The jam is organized by the nonprofit Blues Society of Western New York, which promotes blues music throughout the region.
